{{Quote|Chairman, get down!|A Pantoran Guard, to [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]], during the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|Battle of Orto Plutonia]]|<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>}}
The '''Pantoran Guard''' was a group of [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] soldiers that were assigned to protect the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]].

==History==
[[File:TCW_Pantoran_guard.png|thumb|left|300px|Two Pantoran Guards in their attire]]
The Guard wore uniforms corresponding to the livery of the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]], with their berets bearing the Guard's symbol. Ceremonial blaster rifles were carried in sheaths and the Guard were also proficient with [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] and [[GL-77 blaster pistol]]s.<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

[[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] chose two loyal guards to accompany him on his mission to [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. During the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|battle]] there, both Pantoran Guards fought valiantly despite their poor defensive position and were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TCWCE" />
